Latin Small Letter C With Cedilla Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Latin Small Letter C With Cedilla is 135. Hold Alt, type 135 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Latin Small Letter C With Cedilla also has the Unicode codepoint U+00E7, so you can type it with Alt+231 on Windows, search for U+00E7 in macOS's Character Viewer, use ç in HTML, or \00E7 in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. On a US Mac keyboard, press ⌥C for Latin Small Letter C With Cedilla; shortcuts can differ on other layouts. HTML also defines the named entity ç for Latin Small Letter C With Cedilla, but the numeric form ç is safer when compatibility is uncertain.

How to type latin small letter c with cedilla on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 1 3 5 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Latin Small Letter C With Cedilla character (ç) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type latin small letter c with cedilla on macOS

On a US keyboard layout, press ⌥C to insert Latin Small Letter C With Cedilla. This shortcut assumes a US layout; other layouts may remap it.

If the shortcut does not work on your layout, open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Latin Small Letter C With Cedilla" and click the character.

How to use latin small letter c with cedilla in code

  • HTML: or , also
  • CSS: content:"\00E7"; ()
  • Python: \u00E7 or chr(0xE7)
  • JavaScript: \u00E7 or String.fromCodePoint(0xE7)
  • JSON: "\u00E7"

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Latin Small Letter C With Cedilla?

The legacy Alt code for Latin Small Letter C With Cedilla is 135. Hold Alt, type 1 3 5 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type ç without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ç, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+231 not work?

Alt+231 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Latin Small Letter C With Cedilla?

The Unicode codepoint for Latin Small Letter C With Cedilla is U+00E7. You can use this value in HTML as ç, in CSS as \00E7, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ç on a Mac?

On a US Mac keyboard, press ⌥C. If that does not work on your layout, open ⌃⌘Space and search for U+00E7.
